items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: You know I played a club here called The Rex and I know the club owner Bob is always amazed that the three brothers get along you know.

ctx.x: Wow. Was there any rivalry with your brothers regarding music?

No. We’ve always gotten along. We never had any kind of arguments that I can see. Basically I was the first one interested in jazz. I got interested in it, I roped my brother John and Joe into it, I got them into it, and then some local kids that were in school with us, I got one of them to play bass and a couple of them played trumpet. But we never really fought over anything. Even to this day we’re still in kind of an agreement. And it’s kind of unusual. You know I played a club here called The Rex and I know…
